summary: The Novo Nordisk Foundation offers three-year postdoctoral fellowships with two years on a research project at ETH Zurich, Switzerland, followed by a return year at a Danish institution. They are for early-career researchers in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology with interdisciplinary projects that could have an impact on human health or sustainability. Each fellowship is funded up to DKK 3.6 million. The 2027 call opened 30 September 2026 and closes 29 January 2027 at 14:00 Copenhagen time.
highlights: PhD in natural or technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology, obtained within five years of the start date.
Needs a confirmed ETH Zurich host PI and a Danish host institution that employs the fellow and administers the grant.
Interdisciplinary project with potential impact on human health or sustainability.
